title: Phase stability, microstructure and thermodynamic properties of NbMoZrTiV lightweight high-entropy refractory alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting with purity of 99.9% metal particles, chamber vacuumed to 1×10⁻⁴ Pa, high purity Ar gas passed through, alloy ingots repeatedly melted at least eight times to ensure homogeneous composition, followed by vacuum high-temperature annealing at 600°C, 800°C and 1000°C respectively with temperature increase rate of 10°C/min, held for 10 h, and finally cooled with the furnace
